# Grace Ashdown

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P5](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P3](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0003), [v5 c2 P5](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P5](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Juneford  <sub>[v5 c4 P53](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0053), [v5 c4 P58](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0058)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v5 c3 P14](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065), [v5 c17 P3](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Grace is an attractive, rosy-cheeked girl with golden-brown eyes and thick, golden-brown curls. She possesses deep dimples in her cheeks when she smiles. Though spirited, she sometimes wears faded or mended dresses and mismatched or worn stockings.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P3](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0003), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c5 P15](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0015), [v5 c10 P15](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0015), [v5 c24 P22](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0022), [v5 c25 P1](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0001)_

## Personality

Grace is an exceptionally high-spirited, energetic, and impulsive girl who is known as a complete tomboy. She is quick to laugh, fiercely protective of those she cares about, and prone to sudden, passionate outbursts when angered or defending her loved ones. Despite her reckless antics, she possesses a generous, warm-hearted nature and a strong sense of justice.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P3](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0003), [v5 c2 P5](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0005), [v5 c2 P15](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0015), [v5 c5 P8](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0008), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c24 P22](../source/v05-c24.md#nw-v05-c24-p0022)_

## History

Grace grew up in Juneford as the second eldest child of the Reverend John Ashdown before moving with her family to the Glen St. Agnes manse. Lacking a mother's guidance, she and her siblings enjoyed an unrestrained upbringing, frequently engaging in lively escapades in Fern Hollow and the old Methodist cemetery. When rumors spread that their antics were bringing dishonor to their father, Grace joined her siblings in founding the Good-Conduct Club to discipline themselves. In an impulsive act of charity, she gave her only good black stockings to a barefoot girl, which eventually led to her attending church bare-legged and causing a local scandal. To clear her father of blame, she publicly addressed the congregation, and later confronted the formidable Lionel Fairlie, winning his respect and securing his financial support for her father's church. When her father eventually courted and married Clementine Ainslie, Grace warmly embraced her new stepmother, finding in her the guidance and affection her family needed.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P0](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0000), [v5 c4 P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 c12 P2](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0002), [v5 c16 P39](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0039), [v5 c16 P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053), [v5 c16 P68](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0068), [v5 c20 P15](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0015), [v5 c23 P65](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0065), [v5 c25 P1](../source/v05-c25.md#nw-v05-c25-p0001), [v5 c34 P15](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0015), [v5 c34 P32](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0032)_
